title: 《Arco》两年销量突破 10 万份并实现回本
content:
Arco tops 100,000 sales in two years and breaks even
Business
PC
Console
News
Arco tops 100,000 sales in two years and breaks even
One member of the development team described the achievement as 'incredible.'
Chris Kerr
,
Senior Editor, News
,
GameDeveloper.com
August 18, 2026
1 Min Read
Image via Panic
Mesoamerican fantasy RPG
Arco
has sold over 100,000 copies worldwide and recouped its development costs. The title eclipsed that sales milestone after two years on shelves, having launched on August 15, 2024.
In an exchange with Game Developer,
Arco
composer and sound designer José Ramón confirmed the project has broken even.
Ramón explained the bulk of sales came through Steam—
Arco
is also available on Nintendo Switch, Mac App Store, and the Epic Games Store—and said good chunk of owners have been playing on Steam Deck.
"The milestone is especially great in terms of self-satisfaction. It's incredible to believe that more than 100.000 people have played—and hopefully enjoyed—something that we worked so hard on," he added.
At launch, we
spoke with the
Arco
development team
to learn how a "fuck around and find out" philosophy became the backbone of the title's simultaneous turn-based combat.
